title: Rogue Mecha Cop
kicker: Mecha Cop wants to subdue you
body: You hear sirens suddenly explode to life and see a strange police officer jump out from behind a building. "UNAUTHORIZED TRAINER. PREPARE TO BE SUBDUED."
resultTitle: One less cop terrorizing the streets.

title: Nursery Surprise
body: A day-care worker presses a warm, wobbling egg into your hands. Before you can even ask, it cracks open right there!
rewardText: The egg hatched into a baby Pokemon!

title: A Slumbering Ice Golem
body: As you wander through the cave, you find yourself in a large empty chamber with a strange inscription on the far wall. The inscription looks familiar to you but you can't quite place it. You pace clockwise around the perimeter of the room trying to jog your memory, when suddenly the inscription glows and the wall disappears, revealing a dormant golem. Suddenly, its eyes begin to glow.

title: A Slumbering Stone Golem
body: While wandering the desert through a sandstorm you find a cave, and decide to take shelter there while you wait out the storm. Inside you find a single cavern with strange inscription on the far wall. However, you don't  notice that, because the storm is still able to reach into the cave, peppering you with sand. In a desperate attempt to go deeper, after stumbling around you have your pokemon smash the far rock wall. To your surprise, you see a second cavern containing a dormant stone golem. Suddenly, its eyes light up.

title: A Slumbering Iron Golem
body: As you cut your way through the dense undergrowth in the pouring rain you find yourself in front of a large cave. You enter, hoping to wait out the storm, but find that it's pitch black. You have one of your pokemon light up the room with Flash, and as you do you hear a thunderous rumble, and see that the far side of the cave has an entrance to a cavern containing a motionless iron giant. Suddenly, its eyes light up.

title: The Great Titan
body: You see an ancient temple and decide to walk inside.As you step in, the entrance behind you closes, and you see a titanic statue of a weird looking Regi. Suddenly, its eyes start glowing, and three more golems with glowing eyes drop from the ceiling.

title: Strange Buzzing TV
body: You pass by an empty room with a TV filled with static making a strange buzzing noise. As you approach it starts to buzz louder, then suddenly a Pokémon jumps out and gives you a kiss!

title: A Forest Pixie
body: You walk into a clearing and discover a small shrine in the middle dedicated to the forest's guardian. You consider whether to leave an offering.

choices.title: Leave an offering
choices.description: Pick an item to leave as an offering.

title: The Legendary Ice Bird
body: While exploring the cave system in the islands, you trip and fall through a hole, landing in a river. Its current sweeps you deeper into the caves and spits you out on a gravelly beach. Soaking, shivering, you slowly get up, and immediately lock eyes with Articuno.

title: The Legendary Thunder Bird
body: While exploring the abandoned power plant, you trip over something. Before you can see what it was, you hear the crackling of an Electrode waking up, and are suddenly thrown back by an explosion. As the dust settles, you stand up wearily, and look back at where you were standing. There is a giant hole in the wall you were standing by earlier, and on the other side of it, Zapdos.

title: The Legendary Fire Bird
body: As you scale the mountain, you see an opening to rest. Sweaty, exhausted, you drag yourself into the cave, only to feel a roaring heat from inside. You look up, and find yourself face-to-face with Moltres.

title: A Voice in your Head
body:
So far, the cave hadn't been too bad. You hadn't seen any of the terrible Pokémon the guard at the entrance of the cave had warned you about, and you started to think he might have been messing with you. Although, what did it matter, since you hadn't listened anyway.
"Though maybe you should have," says a voice in your head. You pause, confused. The voice sounded unnatural, artificial, not how you normally think. You blink, and suddenly a Pokémon appears in front of you. It hovers just above the ground, barely moving, staring directly at you.

title: The Roaming Beast of Fire
body: As you scale the mountain, you suddenly hear a great roar. You turn around, and find yourself face-to-face with Entei. It roars again, challenging you to prove your worth.

title: The Roaming Beast of Water
body: As you wade through the water, you suddenly hear a great roar. You turn around, and find yourself face-to-face with Suicune. It roars again, challenging you to prove your worth.

title: The Roaming Best of Thunder
body: As you push through the undergrowth, you suddenly hear a great roar. You turn around, and find yourself face-to-face with Raikou. It roars again, challenging you to prove your worth.

title: The Rainbow Guardian
body: After climbing the endless stairs of Bell Tower, you finally reach the summit. Waiting there is Ho-Oh, perched silently atop the ancient roof, its rainbow feathers shimmering. It lets out a single cry, and from below, three familiar roars answer in unison. Moments later, Raikou, Entei, and Suicune leap onto the tower, surrounding you.

title: The Guardian of the Sea
body: You finally reach the hidden chamber deep beneath the Whirl Islands. For a moment, it seems completely empty, until a massive shape stirs beneath the surface. Lugia emerges, fixing its gaze on you before letting out a powerful cry. Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres swoop in from the storm outside.

title: Some Strange Appliances
body: You feel Rotom's Pokéball start to vibrate, so you decide to let it out. The Rotom starts buzzing excitedly, and leads you to an empty storage room with a bunch of strange appliances in it. The Rotom looks at you expectantly.

title: Gyarados in the Lake of Rage
body: As you're exploring the lake, you hear vicious roars coming from the center, and see a massive raging Gyarados. You realize it could cause real harm to the nearby town, and that it might be a good idea to

payment.title: Let it eat one of your cards and run away

title: A Terrible Nightmare
body: You are surrounded by darkness, feeling nothing but paralyzing fear. Suddenly, you jolt awake and sit up straight, coming face to face with the living nightmare, Darkrai.

title: Loose Gadgets on the Floor
body: While walking around you trip over a bunch of gadgets on the ground. You decide it would be fine if you took one.

choices.title: Take an Energize
choices.description: Energize lets a Pokémon use a second attack this turn.

choices.title: Take an Increase Capacity
choices.description: Increase capacity lets the player draw one extra card every turn for the rest of the battle.

choices.title: Take a Recycle
choices.description: Recycle lets the player play an extra item card this turn.

choices.title: Take a Refresh
choices.description: Refresh cycles the discard pile back into the deck early.

body: You hear a voice call your name, and turn around to see the Pokémon professor's aide running towards you. "Hey! The professor just found this mega stone for your Venusaur!"
